issues.description: Pressing Enter forwards a Key_Enter/Return event to textedit but still inserts a newline, which may not be the user's intent when dismissing the popup
issues.detail: When the option is disabled and the user presses Enter, the popup hides and the original Key_Return/Enter event is forwarded to textedit via keyPressEvent(event). This will insert a newline in the editor. That is arguably desirable, but it differs from Escape (which only hides). The PR has no test and no documentation clarifying this; users expecting Enter to simply dismiss without newline will be surprised.

issues.description: get_conf is called on every Enter/Tab keypress without a default, risking KeyError for users upgrading without the new option in their config
issues.detail: self.get_conf('use_enter_for_completions', section='completions') is invoked on every Return/Enter/Tab. If a user's persisted config lacks this key (e.g., older config file not migrated), this may raise. Passing default=True would make the new behavior backward-compatible and avoid hard failures during completion handling.

issues.description: Style: use `key != Qt.Key_Tab` instead of `not key == Qt.Key_Tab`
issues.detail: `not key == Qt.Key_Tab` works due to Python precedence (not binds after ==), but `key != Qt.Key_Tab` is the idiomatic form and easier to read at a glance. Minor readability fix in a hot keypress path.

issues.description: New checkbox isn't gated by the parent 'Show completions on the fly' toggle like the after-characters spinbox is
issues.detail: `disable_completion_after_characters` enables/disables the after-chars widgets based on `automatic_completion_box`. The new use_enter_for_completions checkbox is unrelated to automatic completions so it should remain always enabled, but consider grouping it visually near the snippets/hint options rather than between automatic_completion_box and its dependent spinbox row, which fragments the visual grouping.

issues.description: Mixed quoting style: new option key uses double quotes while neighbors use single quotes
issues.detail: Existing config keys in confpage.py use single quotes ('automatic_completions', 'completions_hint'). The new entry uses double quotes ("use_enter_for_completions"). Minor consistency nit but worth aligning with surrounding code.

issues.description: No CONF_VERSION bump or migration note for the new config key under 'completions'
issues.detail: A new key 'use_enter_for_completions' is added to the 'completions' default section in spyder/config/main.py. Spyder typically requires bumping CONF_VERSION (or the plugin's conf version) when adding/changing default config so users with persisted configs get the new key merged. Without it, get_conf may not see the default for existing users.

review.summary: The PR adds a clean opt-in for disabling Enter as a completion-acceptance key, with a new config entry, a preference checkbox, and a short-circuit branch in the completion popup's keyPressEvent. The core logic is correct: when disabled and the key is not Tab, the popup hides and forwards the event to the editor. Main concerns are robustness (no default in get_conf, potential missing CONF_VERSION bump for existing user configs), and minor style/UX questions (forwarding Enter inserts a newline; non-idiomatic `not key ==`; quote style; preference layout). No tests are added for the new behavior.
